author: Fextralife
description:
The Blood of Dawnwalker Beginner Guide - Things I Wish I Knew Sooner
In this video, I'm going to show you some things that I wish I knew before I playing The Blood of Dawnwalker. This is a game that heavily emphasizes player choice and constantly challenges you with tough decisions, and because of the game's time mechanic, it can make every decision very, very important. 
So to help you navigate this high-stakes adventure, I've compiled a list of tips and tricks that can help you get through Vale Sangura and help you avoid a lot of the pitfalls that I encountered while playing through the game.
